mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 55 degrees with clear skies by the Military Ridge State Trail, paired with a waxing gibbous moon.

The City of Verona is seeking an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects until September 20. Additionally, residents can now apply for a 30 dollar rebate on 35-gallon rain barrels to help manage stormwater.
We have plenty to do, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, or Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy incident on August 15, Verona police stopped a driver near North Main Street and Cross Country Road who was ultimately arrested for a first offence O W I.
Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Please note that the store is currently closed and will open today at 10 AM.
